info.title: Exchequer
info.description: Self-hosted household accounting. Amounts are decimal strings, never JSON numbers.

delete.summary: Delete a account nothing refers to.

get.summary: List balance checks, newest first, each compared with the current ledger.

post.summary:
Record what the bank shows and compare it with the ledger. A mismatch
comes with candidate explanations.

409.description: No commodity given and no household currency

get.summary: One balance check, with candidate explanations if it doesn't match.

delete.summary: Delete a category nothing refers to.
Delete a commodity nothing refers to.
Delete a counterparty nothing refers to.

post.summary: Create a party. There can be only one household.

delete.summary: Delete a party nothing refers to.

patch.summary: Rename a party, or set the household currency.

post.summary:
Aggregate postings: filter × group by × bucket (design §7). Read-only,
despite being a POST (the filters don't fit a query string).

get.summary: Each account's balance in each commodity at the end of a day.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Balances at the end of this day.

get.summary:
The household pool for one month: shared income and expenses, stipends,
business funding, and the change in shared savings.

Statements for a range of months, without their lines: the history used
to check migrated data (each edge's `implied_stipend`, design §4.5).

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Last month, `YYYY-MM` (at most 120 months in all).

get.summary: A month's parameters (its own, or carried forward) and whether it's closed.

put.summary:
Set a month's stipends and funders. `If-Match` is the ETag from GET
(`"0"` for a month never set).

409.description: The month is closed, or no household currency yet

post.summary:
Close a month: edits to transactions dated in it are refused until it's
reopened. Needs every person's stipend and every business's funder set
for the month itself.
Reopen a closed month. Always allowed (design §4.4).

get.summary:
The month's statement: each edge's claims, stipend, due, paid,
outstanding and lines (design §4.3). Always computed from current data.

delete.summary: Delete a tag nothing refers to.

get.summary: List every token, revoked ones included.

post.summary: Create a token for one client.

delete.summary: Revoke a token. It stops working immediately; revoking twice is harmless.

parameters.description: Only transactions with a split involving this counterparty.

parameters.name: category_id
parameters.description: Only transactions with a split in this category.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description:
Only transactions whose description, notes or a split's description
contain this text (case-insensitive).

parameters.name: external_source
parameters.description: With `external_ref`: the transaction with this external reference.

422.description: Invalid, or breaks a ledger rule

get.summary: Whether the server is up and can reach its database.

archived.description: Kept for history, hidden from everyday views.

liquid.description:
Investment accounts are not liquid; activity inside them is never
shared (design §4.1).

owner_id.description: The party the account belongs to.

AccountKind.description: Affects display only (sign convention, icon), never a split's kind.

AccountUpdate.description: Fields to change; omitted ones stay as they are. The owner can't change.

candidates.description: For a mismatch, on a single check only.

ledger.description: The ledger's balance at the end of `date`, signed like `amount`.

searched_after.description:
For a mismatch: candidates were searched after this date (the last
verified date before the check), or from the beginning if absent.

verified_through.description:
The latest date up to this check's on which a check of the same
account and commodity matched.

balances.description: Every account and commodity whose balance on the date isn't zero.

Candidate.description: A possible explanation for the difference, most likely first.

precision.description: Decimal places a quantity may have: 2 for USD, 0 for JPY.

CommodityUpdate.description: Fields to change; omitted ones stay as they are.

token.description: The full token. Shown only in this response; store it now.

CreditLimit.description: A credit card's limit: display metadata, never part of the balance.

Edge.description:
One edge of the settlement tree (a child and its parent) for one month.
Positive amounts go from the child to the parent.

carried.description:
`outstanding` at the end of the previous month: past differences,
including corrections to closed months, carried into this one.

claims.description: Regular claims across the edge this month.

implied_stipend.description: `claims − paid`: the stipend that would explain the payments made.

outstanding.description:
`carried + due − paid` (and in-transit proceeds): everything up to
the end of this month.

paid.description: Regular payments that settle this month.

stipend.description: What the parent owes the child as stipends this month.

to_settle.description:
`outstanding` without the proceeds still in transit: the regular
transfer to make (positive: the child pays).

ExternalRef.description:
Where a transaction came from outside Exchequer, such as its ID in the
system it was migrated from. Unique per `source`.

Funder.description: Who funds a business for the month: the household or a person.

months.description: One statement per month, without lines.

HouseholdPool.description:
The household's month (design §4.3), in the household currency. Amounts
in other commodities aren't included until prices exist.

business_funding.description: How much each business's net funding grew this month.

expenses.description: Spending for the household, by category (negative).

income.description: Income for the household, by category (positive).

shared_savings_change.description: The change in the household's own liquid accounts over the month.

stipends.description: What the household owes each person for the month.

oneOf.description: The payment that cleared it by the end of the month.

Kind.description: Derived from who is on each side; never stored or entered.

Leg.description:
One side of a split: exactly one of `account_id` (yours) or
`counterparty_id` (outside the household).

Line.description: An item on an edge. Positive amounts go from the child to the parent.

liquid.description: Defaults to `false` for brokerage accounts, `true` otherwise.

amount.description: As the bank shows it (owed amounts positive on cards and mortgages).

category_id.description: Only on income, expenses and liquidations.

purpose_id.description:
Who the money was for. Only on income/expense of liquid accounts and
on liquidations.

settles.description:
Settlement payments only: the month (`YYYY-MM`) this payment settles,
when not the month before it's made.

name.description: Which client uses the token, e.g. `alex-laptop-cli`. Unique.

tags.description: Tag names; unknown ones are created.

archived.description: Kept for history, hidden from everyday views.

owner_id.description: The party the account belongs to.

type.description: `urn:exchequer:problem:<slug>`; stable, for clients to match on.

QueryRequest.description: Filters combine with AND; the values inside one filter with OR.

oneOf.description: Split the range into buckets, each named by its first day.

from.description: First day, inclusive. For a balance, where buckets start (default: `to`).

group_by.description:
Rows are always per commodity too. A balance groups by `account` or
`owner` only.

purpose_ids.description: Flow only. Effective purpose, as in `group_by: purpose`.

tags.description: Flow only: transactions with any of these tags.

text.description: Flow only: case-insensitive text in the description or notes.

to.description: Last day, inclusive. Required for a balance.

Row.description:
One row. A grouped field is present (`null` for "none", e.g. no
category); a field not grouped by is absent.

amount.description: At the commodity's precision. Positive: into your accounts.

params_from.description:
The month these parameters were set for: this one, an earlier one
they're carried forward from, or absent when none were ever set.

funders.description: Businesses left out are funded by the household.

liquidation.description: Read-only: a transfer from an investment account into a liquid one.

SplitPointer.description: One split, by its transaction and position.

unpriced.description: Splits left out because they have no value in the household currency.

Stipend.description: What the Household owes a person for the month.

amount.description: In the household currency; zero or more.

Unpriced.description:
A split the settlement couldn't value: neither leg is in the household
currency (prices come later).

schema.description:
Newest schema migration built into this server. Backups record it so
a restore can check compatibility (design §14.2).
